controls: Review candidates are selected only from durable current REVIEW outcomes.
Canonical memberships, REJECT, and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE outcomes are excluded.
The API is Deep-only and clamps invalid or excessive limits.
The summary count is exact while the exposed candidate list is capped at 100.
